subject: german
title: Sprache und Selbst
welcome_lead: Language and identity intertwine. German speakers in Germany, Austria, Switzerland share a tongue with rich variation.
meta_desc: German: language as identity, bilingualism, dialect.
final_note: Each German you speak is another mode of being.

walkthroughs.body_html: Bayrisch, Schwabisch, Plattdeutsch — German dialects can be mutually unintelligible. Hochdeutsch (Standard German) unifies for media and education.
Zweisprachigkeit bereichert das Denken. Research shows cognitive benefits. Cite laut einer Studie.
